We aim to provide modular, fit-for-purpose toolbox that supports the development of ecosystem-specific indicators. 

The vision of the project is to move from a current state of fragmented and ad hoc methods towards fully reproducible workflows that are supported by a community of practice and that integrate seamlessly into online catalogues and reporting tools.


![Schematic representation of the vision of the EIW project. The coloured codes in each box refer to specific work packages of the EIW project plan. Diagram available in [draw.io](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TxnK7BMdlmnkzF72b7TDzEi62u1ebX47/view?usp=sharing)](/figures/EIW-project-plan-context.jpg)

Learn more about the project at <https://ardc.edu.au/project/ecosystem-indicator-workflows/>.

Check our [GitHub organisation](https://github.com/Ecosystem-Indicators-Workflows) for repositories and research projects associated with the Ecosystem Indicators Workflows initiative.
